verdict.rationale: Zoho Books documents a public REST API (v3) whose stated aim is full parity with the web client. The docs cover OAuth 2.0 with scopes, regional endpoints, published rate limits, and a downloadable OpenAPI corpus, and module endpoints such as contacts, organizations and banking are documented. The probe 404s only show the spec isn't at generic well-known paths, which does not contradict the documented OpenAPI download. Missing for 10: independent hands-on or community corroboration of driving the API end-to-end, and agent-friendly doc formats (llms.txt and markdown docs both returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Zoho Books API allows you to perform all the operations that you do with our web client. Zoho Books API is built using REST principles... Every resource is exposed as a URL.
You can make 100 requests per minute per organization
